other_conditions: Participant must be 18 years or older
Must be youth or any individual interested in setting up an industrial/self‑employment venture
Qualification and fee structure are decided by the implementing agency
Preference is given to candidates from SC, ST, women, ex‑servicemen, physically handicapped and BPL categories
Fee exemption is provided for SC, ST, differently‑abled persons, ex‑servicemen, BPL participants and women
Age relaxation may be granted for school drop‑outs at the discretion of the programme head
Selection is based on recommendations of field offices, with final decision by AS&DC (MSME)
benefits_summary: Provides entrepreneurship and skill development training, including awareness, basic and advanced programmes, with fee exemptions for SC, ST, women, BPL and differently‑abled participants.
